attrs.label: Silo Root User
attrs.description:
Root user with access to all actions and resources on the deployment. </br>
It doubles as the "access key" for the Silo deployment.

attrs.label: Silo Root Password
attrs.description:
Root password for the Silo root user.</br>
It doubles as the "secret key" for the Silo deployment.

attrs.label: Domain (Optional)
attrs.description:
Depending on your setup/environment, you may need to leave this blank.
When set together with a certificate, MINIO_SERVER_URL and MINIO_BROWSER_REDIRECT_URL are derived from it.

attrs.label: User ID
attrs.description: The user id that Silo files will be owned by.

attrs.label: Group ID
attrs.description: The group id that Silo files will be owned by.

attrs.label: Port Bind Mode
attrs.description:
The port bind mode.</br>
- Publish: The port will be published on the host for external access.</br>
- Expose: The port will be exposed for inter-container communication.</br>
- None: The port will not be exposed or published.</br>
Note: If the Dockerfile defines an EXPOSE directive,
the port will still be exposed for inter-container communication regardless of this setting.

enum.description: Publish port on the host for external access

1.0.1.readme:
Silo S3

Silo is a community-maintained fork of the open-source MinIO server, published by PGSTY. It is an S3-compatible object storage server with the full web console, and it reads existing MinIO data directories, MINIO_* environment variables and mc clients unchanged.
